colors.name: paper
colors.role: the warm off-white page — every other decision exists against it; the calm comes from how much of this color you see

colors.name: paper-warm
colors.role: breath-circle fills and plate panels — a half-step brighter than the page, like morning light on a tatami; surface only (1.04:1)

colors.name: ink
colors.role: primary text, the wordmark, pose names, strokes — 12.85:1 on paper (AAA)

colors.name: ink-soft
colors.role: secondary text — ink at 70% alpha composited over paper: EN answers, captions, counts, the studio note (5.14:1, AA)

colors.name: clay
colors.role: the single bright accent — the giant STRETCH wordmark fill, breath ring strokes, the long pose-divider line; display/large only (2.94:1, never small text)

colors.name: clay-deep
colors.role: readable clay — kickers, pose ordinals, link underlines, focus ring, ::selection bg with ink text (4.38:1, AA for text)

colors.name: sage
colors.role: rules ONLY — the breath count ticks, soft section hairlines, the breath-circle guide rings (2.72:1 — never functional text)

colors.name: sage-deep
colors.role: readable sage — the breath cue label, the inhale/exhale instruction, secondary accents when clay would be too warm (4.90:1, AA)

fonts.role: the Korean serif — every Hangul glyph, the wordmark 늘어, pose names 산·하늘·나무, the studio's first language; set with vertical metrics in mind so scaleY stretches read as a body reaching
the tall Latin voice — STRETCH, the EN answers, captions, ordinals; a long-ascender serif that elongates gracefully when scaleY grows

texture: Almost none. The texture is light and air: stacked translucent breath-circles (paper-warm at 60–92% alpha) drifting behind the type, 1px sage hairlines (the breath count, section rules, the long clay pose-divider at scaleX by scroll), and the whitespace itself — section padding runs 14–22vh so the calm reads as composed, not absent. No grain, no noise filters; the only 'material' is the softness of warm paper against warm paper.

motion.name: ease-breathe
motion.value: cubic-bezier(0.45, 0, 0.2, 1) — the default; slow inhale, even longer exhale. Nothing snaps on a wellness page.

motion.name: ease-stretch
motion.value: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) — ease-out with a long reach: the type keeps lengthening past the midpoint like a held pose

motion.name: ease-recoil
motion.value: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.24, 0.4, 1) — a 12% overshoot for the wordmark settle only; one small sigh, never a bounce

motion.name: breath cycle
motion.value: 12s ease-in-out infinite alternate — the background circles scale 1→1.06 and back; one full inhale-exhale per 12s (paused offscreen / reduced motion)

motion.name: wordmark settle
motion.value: STRETCH chars scaleY 0.78→1 + 6% reach, clay fill-in 1400ms ease-breathe, per-glyph 80ms stagger

motion.name: scrub lerp
motion.value: value += (target − value) × (1 − 0.88^(dt/16.7)) — slower than yeobaek (half-life ≈ 5.4 frames); calm catch-up, never snappy

motion.name: pose stretch
motion.value: scaleY = 1 + scrub×1.8 → up to 2.8× — headline glyphs elongate as you hold the scroll through each pose, releasing as you leave

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: 760ms ease-breathe, translateY(18px) → 0, 90ms stagger per observer batch — a touch slower and softer than the default

motion.name: pointer drift
motion.value: translate (±10px to ±28px) lerped at 0.06/frame, depth by --st-depth; capped, never overshoots

motion.name: underline
motion.value: in 520ms ease-breathe scaleX 0→1 from left; out 200ms — the studio link underline, a quiet reach
